name: Material
signature: public sealed class Material : Asset, ISerializationCallbackReceiver

docs.summary: A shader with values for its properties and keywords. It keeps its values itself, so it saves, loads and works headless, and mirrors them into a Graphite material once a renderer draws with it.
Returns a new material of the Lit shader.
A fresh copy of a built in material, so callers can change it without touching anyone else's.
The material's shader. Never set, it is the parent's, or Lit without a parent. Missing or failed to load, it is the Invalid shader, so the problem shows.
The material this one is a variant of: every value, keyword and surface setting it does not set itself comes from the parent, and follows the parent's changes.
Names of the properties set on this material. The others read the shader's defaults.

docs.summary: Sets the value of a keyword axis, such as `_SURFACE` to `CUTOUT`.
The value a keyword axis draws with: set here or on a parent, else what the surface and properties drive, else the axis default. Headless, only what is set here or on a parent.
Whether this material sets the axis itself.
Forgets the keyword set for an axis, so it follows the surface, properties or parent again.
Whether a toggle keyword is on.
The keyword axes this material sets.

How the surface draws: opaque, cut out or transparent, its blend and culling. Shaders of the standard family follow it through their _SURFACE axis, and any shader takes its render state and queue. Null inherits the parent's, and with none the shader's own passes decide.
Whether this material sets its surface itself rather than taking the parent's or the shader's.
The queue the material draws in. Negative takes the surface's, the parent's, or else the shader's.
Whether this material sets its queue itself.
Whether objects drawn with the material cast shadows.

docs.summary: The Graphite material, made with every value on first use. Null when headless or when neither the shader nor the Invalid shader parsed.
Moves the payload of a freshly read copy into this object. The copy owns nothing afterwards.

Frees native resources and anything derived from the payload. Runs when the asset unloads, before a refill and when a runtime asset is disposed. The database resets every field to its shell value afterwards.
